rules.statement: When an authority is given to two or more persons to do an act, the act is valid to bind the principal only when all of them concur in doing it, unless express words indicate otherwise.
rules.supporting_quote: "The rule laid down in Story on Agency, section 42, is that 'where an authority is given to two or more persons to do an act, the act is valid to bind the principal only when all of them concur in doing it, for the authority is construed strictly and the power is understood to be joint and not several; '"
